assets.baseCharacter: The library's own mannequin mesh (the 'Mannequin' object in the glTF, rig 'Armature', 65 bones). No separate base-character pack was downloaded.

filesUsed.role: Mannequin mesh, rig and 46 actions, no root motion. The only model file render.py reads.

filesExtractedNotUsed.role: Same actions with root motion baked in.

notes: The Standard tier has 46 actions; the Pro and Source tiers (paid) have the rest and are not used.
Source-tier .blend files are not part of this download; the glTF is imported through Blender's glTF importer.
